machine: Framework Desktop, Ryzen AI Max+ 395 / Radeon 8060S gfx1151, 128 GB, Ubuntu 26.04
repository_checks: Production CMake release build passes on the frozen toolchain image.
Shared C++ formatting check passes for all 488 files in the toolchain container.
Python compilation, benchmark shell syntax, Compose validation and git diff checks pass.

settings.timing_scope: Unprofiled HTTP requests; complete wall time includes cache/snapshot work. Decode rate excludes prefill.
settings.arithmetic: The original descending 32-lane XOR tree, with permlanex16 for offset 16 and DPP row-xmask/add for 8/4/2/1; separate wave64 halves.
settings.quality_scope: Exact quantized-model regression, not complete coding tasks or unquantized-model equivalence.

measurement_notes: The first prepared-batch run was discarded when report generation rejected a missing machine fingerprint. The driver now validates its supplied fingerprint before measuring; retained batch arms start from fresh servers.

Initial prepared-batch cohorts showed lazy shape/controller warm-up. Retained batch timings follow a complete untimed tg128 repetition for every width/fixture group, then three measured repetitions; initial timings are retained only as raw diagnostics.
The supplied machine fingerprint replaces diagnose's hard-coded Nix compiler/ROCm strings with the verified installed RPM/HIP versions.

profile.scope: Separate CLI C1 sampled/thinking tg128 profiles at capacity 4096; loading excluded. Decode tail starts at the first one-token embedding, including draft catch-up.

batch.warmup: One complete tg128 repetition per width/fixture group, followed by three measured repetitions. Every session is prepared before each cohort.
batch.timed_scope: Median per-cohort sum of individual decode rates; all sessions prepared before decoding. Mixed prose/edit-code.

micro.scope: Interleaved HIP event timings, five repeats of 32 launches; cold weight rings >=64 MiB. Bitwise comparison for every ring slot.

qualification.dense_operator: 32 standalone Q8 cases byte-exact; dense scalar/batch/gated/ragged grouping, guards, graph replay and independent FP64 head dots pass, including small activations.
qualification.routed_operator: Q4_K/Q5_K/Q5_1/Q8_0 vector grouping, separate/fused SwiGLU, duplicated/inactive experts, ragged rows, nonfinite scales and guards pass.
qualification.batch_state: C2/C4/C6/C8 full logits, tokens and RNG match isolated execution; cancellation, bounded rollback, peer snapshot during graph capture, sampled residual and independent state pass.
qualification.lookup: At 224/32768 tokens: greedy full logits/tokens/RNG, snapshot rebuilding and sampled replay exact; 41/45 and 48/48 copied proposals accepted.
qualification.sampling: All 23 configurations pass AR/MTP, C2 and budget replay.
qualification.http: 30/30 short tg128, 18/18 long-turn and 66/66 prepared mixed-batch requests match baseline completion hashes and counts; long/batch cache counts match.
qualification.opencode_http: All eight long-history, streamed reasoning/tool calls, tool-result continuation and strict JSON cases match the snapshot fork; 134063 prompt tokens reused exactly on repeat.
qualification.vision: No matching vision sidecar installed; no local vision qualification.
